source='''def transform(grid):
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    pts = [(r, c) for r in range(h) for c in range(w) if grid[r][c] != 0]
    if not pts:
        return [row[:] for row in grid]
    r0, r1 = min(r for r, c in pts), max(r for r, c in pts)
    c0, c1 = min(c for r, c in pts), max(c for r, c in pts)
    perimeter = [grid[r][c] for r in range(r0, r1 + 1) for c in range(c0, c1 + 1)
                 if r in (r0, r1) or c in (c0, c1)]
    frame = max(set(perimeter), key=perimeter.count)
    inner = {grid[r][c] for r in range(r0, r1 + 1) for c in range(c0, c1 + 1)
             if grid[r][c] not in (0, frame)}
    fill = next(iter(inner))
    top = 0
    while r0 + top <= r1 and all(grid[r0 + top][c] == frame for c in range(c0, c1 + 1)):
        top += 1
    bottom = 0
    while r1 - bottom >= r0 and all(grid[r1 - bottom][c] == frame for c in range(c0, c1 + 1)):
        bottom += 1
    left = 0
    while c0 + left <= c1 and all(grid[r][c0 + left] == frame for r in range(r0, r1 + 1)):
        left += 1
    right = 0
    while c1 - right >= c0 and all(grid[r][c1 - right] == frame for r in range(r0, r1 + 1)):
        right += 1
    band = min(top, bottom, left, right)
    out = [row[:] for row in grid]
    for r in range(max(0, r0 - band), min(h, r1 + band + 1)):
        for c in range(max(0, c0 - band), min(w, c1 + band + 1)):
            if out[r][c] == 0:
                out[r][c] = fill
    return out
'''
